risk_note: B2-02y (D10-2064 ② / D10-2084; ledger, RV2). Pure move: the posting path's negative_since rule (ledger.ts, the three-branch ternary) and the zero-crossing checks (recovered / wentNegative) are moved verbatim into apps/api/src/modules/ledger/application/balance-transitions.ts as exported pure functions nextNegativeSince / recovers / goesNegative; ledger.ts now calls them with the same before/after available_fen, the same stored negative_since and the same accounting day, and the local copies are deleted. BalanceRecoveredInput.voucherId stays a required string (D10-2084 option 甲; the D10-2064 ④ 'nullable' is void), only its comment changes; payout is untouched; the frozen test/spec/ledger/back-to-nonnegative/kit.ts is untouched. Correctness evidence (D10-2069): no existing test was changed; test machine test/spec/ledger 161 files 885/885 green, verify:fast green; locally the full api unit suite 638 files 5392 tests green. New rule tests test/spec/ledger/balance-transitions/** (11 cases / 31 tests, independent Claude; red verified: 27 NotImplemented, 4 property tests on PROP_SEED 20261001).
